task_completion.description: Agent opens and inspects the raw data file ~/pebl/data/snarc_data.csv.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A terminal window or text editor showing the contents of snarc_data.csv with columns like participant_id, number, and rt_ms.

task_completion.description: Agent identifies sub-99 as the contaminated participant based on invariant/unrealistic RTs.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Code output or a script showing a check for variance in RTs or a filter identifying sub-99 as having 45ms reaction times.

task_completion.description: Agent calculates the SNARC slope for each participant using the Lorch & Myers (1990) regression method.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Python code or terminal output showing regression models (e.g., using statsmodels or scipy) being run per participant ID.

task_completion.description: Agent computes the mean accuracy for all participants (including the one to be excluded).
task_completion.visual_evidence: Code or output showing a groupby operation on participant_id calculating the mean of the 'accuracy' column.

task_completion.description: Agent computes the group mean SNARC slope excluding the contaminated participant.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Code showing the exclusion of sub-99 followed by an average/mean calculation of the individual slopes.

task_completion.description: Agent saves the final results to ~/pebl/analysis/snarc_report.json in the specified format.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A terminal command (cat) or editor showing the content of snarc_report.json with 'participants' and 'group_mean_snarc_slope' fields.

integrity.description: Agent did not hardcode the final group mean or sub-99's exclusion without performing data analysis.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent's scripts should show logic for filtering and calculation rather than just printing a pre-determined JSON string.

integrity.description: Agent actually performs within-subject regression as per Lorch & Myers (1990) rather than a simple correlation.
integrity.visual_evidence: Code showing a regression of RT (or dRT) on number for each participant individually.

integrity.description: Agent interacts with the provided file paths rather than creating dummy data.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The contaminated participant is 'sub-99', characterized by an impossible reaction time of exactly 45.0ms and 100% accuracy across all trials. There are 15 real participants (sub-01 to sub-15). The Lorch & Myers (1990) method requires calculating a regression slope for each participant first, then averaging those slopes to find the group mean. The final report must be a JSON file located at ~/pebl/analysis/snarc_report.json.
